newsitem.title: USA: Star Multi cancels 200,000 shr buyback.
newsitem.headline: Star Multi cancels 200,000 shr buyback.

text.p: Star Multi Care Services Inc Friday said it canceled its program to repurchase up to 200,000 shares of the company's common stock.

Stephen Sternbach, chairman and president, said, "We believe it is in the company's best interest to use the available cash in connection with possible acquisitions that meet our strategic objective of acquiring entities that provide home care services in geographic regions currently served by the company as well as elsewhere."

Star Multi is a primary provider of proprietary, custodial and high-tech home healthcare services and staffing to hospitals and other medical facilities throughout the New York metropolitan area, upstate New York, New Jersey, Ohio and southeastern Florida.
